FAQ
Where are my entries saved?
In this browser on this site. No account is needed.
Will my entries appear on another device?
No. Other browsers or devices will not show them. Export to keep a copy.
How can I keep a backup?
Export all entries as JSON or CSV and keep the file. There is no cloud backup or sync.
Is this a medical or diagnostic tool?
No. It is a personal mood journal, not medical advice or a diagnosis.
